title: MCP services
intro: MCP servers for AI assistants. Connect an MCP client (Streamable HTTP) to a service's endpoint below. The services are read-only.
ecosystemIntro: Search CKAN extensions and see which portals run them, from the CKAN ecosystem data datHere publish on GitHub (MIT).
tematresIntro: Search and browse controlled vocabularies published with TemaTres: on vocabularyserver.com (the UNESCO Thesaurus and others), at most 5 requests a second, and a lunfardo lexicon on terminologias.filo.uba.ar (University of Buenos Aires), at most 2 a second, and a test copy of the UNESCO Thesaurus on vocab.hagstrom.nu. Read through TemaTres's web service.
limits: A proof of concept: no sign-in, no availability promise; it may be rate-limited or taken down. The arguments of each call (the search text, for example) are logged.
status: Not affiliated with the onData association; the engine is derived from their ckan-mcp-server (MIT).
loginTitle: Log in to the write test
loginIntro: This service can change the test vocabulary skrivprov. Type the password to let your MCP client in; it stays logged in as long as it is used at least every 90 days.
loginBadRequest: This login request cannot be used. Start the login again from your MCP client.
